'''The Scattering''' was a [[Asteroid field/Legends|asteroid field]] orbiting the [[Binary star/Legends|binary stars]] [[Toydar/Legends|Toydar]] and [[Little Toydar/Legends|Little Toydar]] in the [[Toydaria system/Legends|Toydaria system]] located in [[Hutt Space/Legends|Hutt Space]] region of the [[The galaxy/Legends|the galaxy]], it was situated between the [[Planet/Legends|planets]] [[Credquant]] and [[Nubisa]].
